name: Hail of Gunfire grants 10% ranged haste (#3358)
contract: Hail of Gunfire 804187 reads 'Increases your ranged haste by $s1%.' In the installed Spell.dbc it is a passive, family 21, with one effect: SPELL_AURA_MOD_RANGED_HASTE (140), BasePoints 9 (DieSides 1, so 10%), self target, no class mask. AuraEffect::HandleAuraModRangedHaste (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:5012) calls Unit::ApplyAttackTimePercentMod(RANGED_ATTACK), which divides the ranged attack time by 1.10 (Unit.cpp:14145), so the expected ratio 1/1.10 = 0.9091 comes from the DBC amount. The module never touches 804187. The stale hidden-aura tooltip that mentions Quickdraw is client-only and not asserted.

steps.label: Let the weapon swap cooldown expire
Ranged swing time before any haste
Ranged swing time is 1/1.10 of the base
Swing time returns to the base
